methodology.forward_validation: Each event is selected using only strictly prior history; its own 1D/3D/5D market outcome is evaluated afterward.
methodology.lookahead_control: Only strictly earlier timestamps contribute; equal-timestamp events are batched.
methodology.warning: Research-only; forward outcome validation is not a live trading backtest.

purpose: point-in-time historical-edge replay with warm-up diagnostics, threshold sensitivity, and forward outcome validation
